companies.description: ABB is a technology leader in electrification and automation, offering a wide range of products and services to enable a more sustainable and resource-efficient future. Their typical customers are industrial and manufacturing companies, as well as businesses in the energy sector. ABB differentiates themselves by connecting engineering know-how and software to optimize how things are manufactured, moved, powered, and operated, driving innovations that accelerate industrial transformation.
companies.name: ABB Asea Brown Boveri Ltd.

companies.description: Shermco Industries, Inc. is an appliances, electrical, and electronics manufacturing company. It offers electrical power system services, specializing in testing, maintenance, repair, and engineering for high-voltage equipment, data centers, and renewable energy sites. The company serves clients throughout the United States and Canada.
companies.name: Shermco Industries, Inc.

companies.description: Megger Group provides solutions for the energy sector, specializing in testing, monitoring, and software for electrical and water networks. It provide testing, monitoring, and software to support power and water infrastructure. It serves various sectors including service companies, data centers, electricians, renewables, OEM and industrial sectors, transportation, and utilities. Megger Group was formerly known as AVO International. It was founded in 1889 and is based in Dover, United Kingdom.
companies.name: Megger Group Limited

companies.description: RESA Power, LLC provides rental and turnkey temporary power systems, including generators, distribution, load banks, fuel logistics, and on-site installation and maintenance for business and institutional clients. They serve utilities, construction/industrial sites, data centers, events, and similar customers that need emergency, supplemental, or project-based power, and they emphasize engineered solutions and rapid deployment as differentiators.
companies.name: RESA Power, LLC

companies.description: Maddox Industrial Transformer, LLC supplies, manufactures, and reconditions industrial and commercial electrical transformers and related switchgear, serving contractors, utilities, data centers, and other business customers. They emphasize large in‑stock inventory and short lead times, and provide complementary services including rentals, repairs/field service, and surplus equipment purchasing.
companies.name: Maddox Industrial Transformer, LLC
